## Analytics

### generateReport

`analytics.generateReport`

Generate report. Returns aggregated marketing analytics grouped by message send date. Covers delivery, engagement, and revenue attribution metrics for campaigns and automations. Supports optional dimensions (timestamp, channel, activity), filters, and up to 4 queries per request.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.analytics.generateReport({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `queries` | `object[]` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="queries full type">

```ts
{
  alias?: string,
  dateRange?: {
    from?: string,
    interval?: string,
    to?: string
  },
  dimensions?: {
    granularity?: string,
    name?: string
  }[],
  filters?: {
    name?: string,
    operator?: string,
    values?: string[]
  }[],
  metrics?: {
    name?: string
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `reports` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="reports full type">

```ts
{
  alias?: string | null,
  dimensions?: {
    granularity?: string | null,
    name?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  metrics?: {
    name?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  rows?: Record<string, any>[] | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### generateStatistics

`analytics.generateStatistics`

Generate report. Returns aggregated marketing analytics grouped by event date (when opens, clicks, orders actually occurred). Covers delivery, engagement, revenue attribution, and audience growth metrics. Requires a timestamp dimension.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.analytics.generateStatistics({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `queries` | `object[]` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="queries full type">

```ts
{
  alias?: string,
  dateRange?: {
    from?: string,
    to?: string
  },
  dimensions?: {
    granularity?: string,
    name?: string
  }[],
  filters?: {
    name?: string,
    operator?: string,
    values?: string[]
  }[],
  metrics?: {
    name?: string
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `statistics` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="statistics full type">

```ts
{
  alias?: string | null,
  dimensions?: {
    granularity?: string | null,
    name?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  metrics?: {
    name?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  rows?: Record<string, any>[] | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Automations

### copy

`automations.copy`

Copy automation workflow. Create a copy of an existing automation workflow. The copy is always created in a disabled state, regardless of the source automation's status. The request body is optional. When provided, you can specify a custom name for the copy.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.copy({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID to copy (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `name` | `string` | No | Custom name for the copied automation workflow. When omitted, defaults to "Copy of: &lt;original name&gt;". |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). Omitted from list responses with `view=summary` unless `include=blocks` is passed. |
| `brandID` | `string \| null` | No | Brand identifier (read-only) |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was disabled (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was enabled (read-only) |
| `exitConditions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Exit conditions that remove contacts from the automation workflow (evaluated with OR logic) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow unique identifier (read-only) |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the automation workflow is enabled (read-only). Controlled via enable/disable actions. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object \| null` | No | Automation settings |
| `trigger` | `object \| null` | No | Automation trigger configuration |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link to the automation workflow editor in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

---

### create

`automations.create`

Create automation workflow. Create a new automation workflow.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.create({
	blocks: [{ temporaryID: 'tmp-1', type: 'delay' }],
	name: 'Spring sale',
	trigger: {
		condition: { event: 'placed order' },
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocks` | `object[]` | Yes | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). At least one block is required. |
| `exitConditions` | `object[]` | No | Exit conditions. When a contact triggers any of these events, they are immediately removed from the workflow. Multiple exit conditions are evaluated with OR logic. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object` | No | Automation settings (sending thresholds, frequency, overlap, etc.). Omit to use engine defaults. |
| `trigger` | `object` | Yes | Trigger configuration |

| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). Omitted from list responses with `view=summary` unless `include=blocks` is passed. |
| `brandID` | `string \| null` | No | Brand identifier (read-only) |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was disabled (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was enabled (read-only) |
| `exitConditions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Exit conditions that remove contacts from the automation workflow (evaluated with OR logic) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow unique identifier (read-only) |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the automation workflow is enabled (read-only). Controlled via enable/disable actions. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object \| null` | No | Automation settings |
| `trigger` | `object \| null` | No | Automation trigger configuration |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link to the automation workflow editor in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

---

### delete

`automations.delete`

Delete automation workflow. Delete a single automation workflow by ID. This operation is idempotent — deleting a non-existent automation returns a success response. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.delete({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### deleteSchedule

`automations.deleteSchedule`

Delete automation workflow schedule. Remove the scheduled start and end of an automation workflow. isEnabled is not changed. This operation is idempotent — deleting a schedule that does not exist returns a success response. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.deleteSchedule({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### disable

`automations.disable`

Disable automation workflow. Disable an automation workflow. Once disabled, the workflow stops accepting new trigger events. Use contactsInWorkflow to control what happens to contacts currently progressing through the workflow: - keep: contacts remain and continue through the remaining blocks until completion.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.disable({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0', contactsInWorkflow: 'keep' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `contactsInWorkflow` | `keep \| exit` | Yes | What to do with contacts currently in the workflow |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). Omitted from list responses with `view=summary` unless `include=blocks` is passed. |
| `brandID` | `string \| null` | No | Brand identifier (read-only) |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was disabled (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was enabled (read-only) |
| `exitConditions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Exit conditions that remove contacts from the automation workflow (evaluated with OR logic) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow unique identifier (read-only) |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the automation workflow is enabled (read-only). Controlled via enable/disable actions. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object \| null` | No | Automation settings |
| `trigger` | `object \| null` | No | Automation trigger configuration |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link to the automation workflow editor in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

---

### enable

`automations.enable`

Enable automation workflow. Enable an automation workflow. Once enabled, the workflow starts processing trigger events in real time. The request body is optional. Use enrollExisting to also enroll contacts who already qualify at the time of enabling. An enabled automation emails or texts contacts on its own whenever its trigger fires.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.enable({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `enrollExisting` | `boolean` | No | Whether to enroll contacts who already meet the trigger conditions. When omitted or false, only future trigger events are processed. When `enrollExisting=true`: - **Event-based triggers** (e.g. "placed order", "started checkout"): contacts whose trigger event occurred within the first delay block's time window are enrolled. They receive messages based on their original event time, not when the workflow was enabled (e.g. 30-day delay, event 20 days ago → message in 10 days). The workflow **must** start with a delay block — otherwise the request is rejected with 409 `enroll-existing-not-applicable`. - **"Entered segment" trigger**: all contacts currently in the trigger's segments are enrolled immediately. Takes effect only on the first enable; re-enabling with `enrollExisting=true` is rejected with 409 `enroll-existing-not-applicable`. Copy the workflow if a fresh enrollment is needed. - **Birthday, "Product back in stock", and custom virtual events**: not supported; `enrollExisting=true` is rejected with 409 `enroll-existing-not-applicable`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). Omitted from list responses with `view=summary` unless `include=blocks` is passed. |
| `brandID` | `string \| null` | No | Brand identifier (read-only) |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was disabled (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was enabled (read-only) |
| `exitConditions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Exit conditions that remove contacts from the automation workflow (evaluated with OR logic) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow unique identifier (read-only) |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the automation workflow is enabled (read-only). Controlled via enable/disable actions. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object \| null` | No | Automation settings |
| `trigger` | `object \| null` | No | Automation trigger configuration |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link to the automation workflow editor in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

---

### get

`automations.get`

Get automation workflow. Get a single automation workflow by ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.get({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). Omitted from list responses with `view=summary` unless `include=blocks` is passed. |
| `brandID` | `string \| null` | No | Brand identifier (read-only) |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was disabled (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was enabled (read-only) |
| `exitConditions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Exit conditions that remove contacts from the automation workflow (evaluated with OR logic) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow unique identifier (read-only) |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the automation workflow is enabled (read-only). Controlled via enable/disable actions. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object \| null` | No | Automation settings |
| `trigger` | `object \| null` | No | Automation trigger configuration |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link to the automation workflow editor in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

### getBlockUtm

`automations.getBlockUtm`

Get UTM tags for an automation block. Retrieve UTM tracking tags for a specific send-action block. Missing or cleared tags are returned with their default values.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.getBlockUtm({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0', blockID: 'block-1' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `blockID` | `string` | Yes | Block identifier |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tags` | `object \| null` | No | UTM tag values |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="tags full type">

```ts
{
  campaign?: string | null,
  medium?: string | null,
  source?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getSchedule

`automations.getSchedule`

Get automation workflow schedule. Get the scheduled start and end of an automation workflow. Returns 204 No Content when the workflow has no schedule.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.getSchedule({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  contactsInWorkflow?: string | null,
  endAt?: string | null,
  startAt?: string | null,
  startFailedAt?: string | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getUtm

`automations.getUtm`

Get aggregated UTM tags for all blocks. Retrieve UTM tracking tags for all send-action blocks in an automation. Each block's tags include default-value synthesis for missing fields.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.getUtm({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | UTM tags per send-action block |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="blocks full type">

```ts
{
  blockID?: string | null,
  tags?: {
    campaign?: string | null,
    medium?: string | null,
    source?: string | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`automations.list`

List automation workflows. List automation workflows with filtering, sorting, and cursor-based pagination.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Number of items per page. Range: 1-250. Default: 100 |
| `after` | `string` | No | Opaque cursor for the next page |
| `before` | `string` | No | Opaque cursor for the previous page |
| `sort` | `createdAt \| updatedAt` | No | Sort field. Default: createdAt |
| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction. Default: desc |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean` | No | If true, only enabled automations; if false, only disabled. Omit for no filter. |
| `nameContains` | `string` | No | Filter by name (partial match, max 200 characters) |
| `createdAtFrom` | `string` | No | Filter automations created after this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `createdAtTo` | `string` | No | Filter automations created before this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `updatedAtFrom` | `string` | No | Filter automations updated after this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `updatedAtTo` | `string` | No | Filter automations updated before this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `view` | `summary` | No | Response shape. `summary` omits the heavy `blocks` tree from every item. Omit for the full representation. |
| `include` | `blocks[]` | No | Heavy sections to keep in summary view (repeatable or comma-separated): `blocks` (full workflow blocks tree). Only meaningful together with `view=summary`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `automations` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of automations |
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information |

---

### replaceBlocks

`automations.replaceBlocks`

Replace automation workflow blocks. Replace the full block tree for an automation workflow. Blocks identified by id are updated in place. Blocks identified by temporaryID are created as new blocks. Existing blocks not included in this array are removed. Enabled automations cannot be restructured.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.replaceBlocks({
	id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0',
	blocks: [{ type: 'delay' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `blocks` | `object[]` | Yes | Full block list. Replaces the entire block tree. At least one block is required. Blocks with id update existing blocks; blocks with temporaryID create new ones. Existing blocks not included in this array are removed. |

| `blocks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Automation workflow blocks (actions, delays, splits, A/B tests). Omitted from list responses with `view=summary` unless `include=blocks` is passed. |
| `brandID` | `string \| null` | No | Brand identifier (read-only) |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was disabled (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp when automation was enabled (read-only) |
| `exitConditions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Exit conditions that remove contacts from the automation workflow (evaluated with OR logic) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow unique identifier (read-only) |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the automation workflow is enabled (read-only). Controlled via enable/disable actions. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object \| null` | No | Automation settings |
| `trigger` | `object \| null` | No | Automation trigger configuration |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Automation last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link to the automation workflow editor in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

### sendBlockTestEmail

`automations.sendBlockTestEmail`

Send test email. Send the saved email content of a specific email block as a test email to up to 5 recipients. The email is rendered and delivered asynchronously. Sends a real email to the given addresses.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.sendBlockTestEmail({
	id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0',
	blockID: 'block-1',
	recipients: ['example'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `blockID` | `string` | Yes | Block identifier |
| `recipients` | `string[]` | Yes | Email addresses to deliver the test email to (1 to 5 recipients). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### setBlockUtm

`automations.setBlockUtm`

Update UTM tags for an automation block. Set UTM tracking tags for a specific send-action block. All three tag fields are replaced atomically. Send an empty string to clear a field — the next read will return its default value.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.setBlockUtm({
	id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0',
	blockID: 'block-1',
	tags: { campaign: 'spring-sale', medium: 'email', source: 'newsletter' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `blockID` | `string` | Yes | Block identifier |
| `tags` | `object` | Yes | UTM tag values |

### setSchedule

`automations.setSchedule`

Save automation workflow schedule. Schedule when an automation workflow is enabled (startAt), disabled (endAt), or both. The request replaces the whole schedule. Saving a schedule does not change isEnabled. - startAt can be set only for a disabled workflow. At startAt the workflow is enabled the same way as with the enable action.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.setSchedule({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `contactsInWorkflow` | `keep \| exit` | No | What to do at `endAt` with contacts currently in the workflow. Required when `endAt` is set. |
| `endAt` | `string` | No | Time to disable the workflow (RFC 3339). Seconds are truncated. Must be after `startAt`. |
| `startAt` | `string` | No | Time to enable the workflow (RFC 3339). Seconds are truncated. Not allowed for an enabled workflow. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `schedule` | `object \| null` | No | Saved schedule |
| `warnings` | `object[] \| null` | No | Problems that would stop the workflow from being enabled at `startAt`. The schedule is saved regardless. A workflow problem points at its `field`. An account problem, such as blocked email sending or an unverified sender domain, has an empty `field`. Empty when the workflow can be enabled |
| `warningsDetail` | `string \| null` | No | What happens when `warnings` are not resolved before `startAt`. Present only when `warnings` is not empty |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="schedule full type">

```ts
{
  contactsInWorkflow?: string | null,
  endAt?: string | null,
  startAt?: string | null,
  startFailedAt?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="warnings full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  field?: string | null,
  message?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### update

`automations.update`

Patch automation workflow. Partially update an automation workflow. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated. Enabled automations cannot be patched. Disable the automation via POST /automations/&#123;id&#125;/disable, make changes, then re-enable via POST /automations/&#123;id&#125;/enable when ready.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.automations.update({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Automation workflow ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `blocks` | `object[]` | No | Automation workflow blocks. Each entry updates an existing block matched by `id`; fields within each block are applied as a partial update. The array does **not** reshape the block list — adding or removing blocks is not supported through this endpoint (use the dedicated block endpoints for that). An empty array (`[]`) is rejected with `400`; omit the field to leave blocks unchanged. |
| `exitConditions` | `object[]` | No | Exit condition list. Replaces all existing exit conditions when provided. Send `null` or an empty array (`[]`) to clear all exit conditions; omit to leave unchanged. |
| `name` | `string` | No | Automation workflow name |
| `settings` | `object` | No | Automation settings patch. Only provided sub-fields are updated. |
| `trigger` | `object` | No | Trigger configuration. Only provided sub-fields are updated. |

## Batches

### create

`batches.create`

Queue up to 100 contact, product, category or event writes that Omnisend applies one by one, and read the batch back with batches.get until it is finished or stopped. An events batch can start automations that message customers, like events.send.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.batches.create({
	endpoint: 'products',
	items: ['example'],
	method: 'POST',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `endpoint` | `products \| contacts \| events \| categories` | Yes | — |
| `items` | `any[]` | Yes | — |
| `method` | `POST \| PUT` | Yes | — |
| `origin` | `string` | No | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `batchID` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `totalCount` | `number \| null` | No | — |

## Brands

### connect

`brands.connect`

Connect brand. With this endpoint you can connect your site to Omnisend. Note it's only possible to connect store with oAuth flow. Links the brand to an ecommerce platform; meant for platform apps.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.brands.connect({ platform: 'custom', version: '1', website: 'https://shop.example.com' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `currency` | `string` | No | — |
| `platform` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `version` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `website` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### getCurrent

`brands.getCurrent`

Get information about brand. With this endpoint you can get brand's information.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.brands.getCurrent({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### create

`campaigns.create`

Create a campaign; a regular email campaign needs a template id, and creating with no verified sender answers 422.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.create({
	name: 'Spring sale',
	type: 'regular',
	channel: 'email',
	content: {
		email: { subject: 'Spring sale starts today', senderName: 'Corsair Shop', templateID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d5' },
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `abTest` | `object` | No | A/B test configuration. Required when type is "abTest". Variants carry per-variant content; omit the top-level content field. |
| `audience` | `object` | No | Campaign audience. Included and excluded segments must not overlap |
| `boosterSettings` | `object` | No | Booster settings. Required when type is "booster" |
| `channel` | `email \| push \| sms` | Yes | Campaign message channel |
| `content` | `object` | No | Campaign content. Required for regular campaigns (not required for booster or abTest). Populated based on channel |
| `language` | `string` | No | Campaign language locale in xx_XX format. Optional; defaults to en_US when not provided. Must be a supported language when specified |
| `name` | `string` | No | Campaign name. Required for regular and abTest campaigns (not required for booster) |
| `sendingSettings` | `object` | No | Campaign sending settings |
| `type` | `regular \| booster \| abTest` | Yes | Campaign type. When `type` is `booster`, there are two supported flows: Flow 1 — draft parent + draft booster: Create a draft parent campaign, then create a draft booster for it (set `boosterSettings.delay` to control when it fires). Send the parent; the booster is scheduled automatically based on the configured delay. Flow 2 — already-sent parent: Create and send a parent campaign first. Once it reaches `sent` status, create the booster campaign (omit `boosterSettings.delay`) and use `sendingSettings.scheduledAt` to set the exact send time. Then call the send endpoint on the booster. |

### list

`campaigns.list`

Page the campaigns, filtered by status, channel, type, name or dates.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Number of items per page. Range: 1-250. Default: 100 |
| `after` | `string` | No | Opaque cursor for the next page |
| `before` | `string` | No | Opaque cursor for the previous page |
| `sort` | `createdAt \| updatedAt \| name` | No | Sort field. Default: createdAt |
| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction. Default: desc |
| `status` | `(error \| onHold \| sent \| paused \| started \| stopped \| expired \| draft \| scheduled \| canceled)[]` | No | Filter by status (repeatable for OR logic) |
| `nameContains` | `string` | No | Filter by name (partial match, max 200 characters) |
| `channel` | `(email \| sms \| push)[]` | No | Filter by message channel (repeatable for OR logic) |
| `type` | `regular \| booster \| abTest` | No | Filter by campaign type. Use `booster` to list only boosters, `abTest` to list only A/B test parents. |
| `parentCampaignID` | `string` | No | Filter to boosters of the given parent campaign ID. Implies type=booster. |
| `createdAtFrom` | `string` | No | Filter campaigns created after this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `createdAtTo` | `string` | No | Filter campaigns created before this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `updatedAtFrom` | `string` | No | Filter campaigns updated after this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `updatedAtTo` | `string` | No | Filter campaigns updated before this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `view` | `summary` | No | Response shape. `summary` omits the heavy `content` and `abTest` sections from every item. Omit for the full representation. |
| `include` | `(content \| abTest)[]` | No | Heavy sections to keep in summary view (repeatable or comma-separated): `content` (full email/SMS/push content), `abTest` (A/B variants, settings and result). Only meaningful together with `view=summary`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `campaigns` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of campaigns |
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information |

### resumeAbTest

`campaigns.resumeAbTest`

Resume A/B test. Resume a stopped A/B test. Automatic winner selection becomes eligible to pick this campaign again. Available only while the campaign is in stopped status. Sending to the test audience starts again.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.resumeAbTest({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Campaign ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### selectAbTestWinner

`campaigns.selectAbTestWinner`

Select A/B test winner. Manually pick a variant as the winner. The chosen variant is routed into the send pipeline immediately. Sends the chosen variant to the rest of the audience.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.selectAbTestWinner({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0', variantID: 'prod-1001-42' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Campaign ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `variantID` | `string` | Yes | ID of the variant to promote as the winner |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### send

`campaigns.send`

Send a draft campaign to its audience. This cannot be undone, and it answers 402 when the audience exceeds the billing tier. Sends the campaign to its whole audience; it cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.send({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Campaign ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### sendTestEmail

`campaigns.sendTestEmail`

Render a campaign and email it to 1-5 addresses. Omnisend sends to exactly the addresses given, so use internal test inboxes, not customers.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.sendTestEmail({
	id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0',
	recipients: ['example'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Campaign ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `recipients` | `string[]` | Yes | Email addresses that receive the test send. Between 1 and 5 addresses. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### stopAbTest

`campaigns.stopAbTest`

Stop A/B test. Halt the A/B test winner-selection phase. While stopped, automatic winner selection no longer considers this campaign until it is resumed. Available only while the campaign is in started status.

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.stopAbTest({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### update

`campaigns.update`

Change a draft campaign; started or scheduled campaigns answer 409.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.campaigns.update({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Campaign ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `abTest` | `object` | No | A/B test settings. Only applicable to A/B campaigns (campaigns with type "abTest"). Full replacement — all provided variant and setting fields replace existing values. templateID / contentID are excluded: templates are set at create time and cannot be changed via PATCH. |
| `audience` | `object` | No | Campaign audience. Included and excluded segments must not overlap |
| `boosterSettings` | `object` | No | Booster-specific settings. Only applicable to booster campaigns (campaigns with type "booster"). |
| `content` | `object` | No | Campaign content. Only specified fields will be updated |
| `language` | `string` | No | Campaign language locale in xx_XX format. Must be a supported language |
| `name` | `string` | No | Campaign name |
| `sendingSettings` | `object` | No | Campaign sending settings. Full object replacement - all fields must be provided when updating |

### create

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.categories.create({ categoryID: 'cat-shoes', title: 'Canvas sneaker' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `categoryID` | `string` | Yes | Product category unique identifier. Range: 1-100 characters |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | Product category name. Max 255 characters |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

## Content Translations

### listLanguages

`contentTranslations.listLanguages`

Get store languages. Returns the languages available for the store's content together with the store's default language.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.contentTranslations.listLanguages({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `defaultLanguage` | `string \| null` | No | Default language code used for the store's content |
| `languages` | `object[] \| null` | No | Languages available for the store's content |

```ts
  name?: string | null
}[] | null
```

## Email Content

### get

`emailContent.get`

Read the content of a campaign email by id.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.emailContent.get({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Content ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Content created at (read-only) |
| `generalSettings` | `object \| null` | No | Content general settings - global and template level styles |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Content unique identifier (read-only) |
| `sections` | `object[] \| null` | No | Content sections |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Content updated at (read-only) |

---

### render

`emailContent.render`

Render a campaign email to its HTML for preview; nothing is sent and no state changes.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.emailContent.render({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Content ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output:** `Record<string, string>`


---

### replace

`emailContent.replace`

Replace a campaign email content in full; omitted fields drop to their defaults.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.emailContent.replace({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Content ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `generalSettings` | `object` | No | Content general settings - global and template level styles |
| `sections` | `object[]` | No | Content sections |

## Events

### defineSchema

`events.defineSchema`

Declare a custom event schema and its property types; a type, once declared, cannot change.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.events.defineSchema({ name: 'Spring sale', origin: 'api' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `displayName` | `string` | No | Human-readable label. Required on POST; omit on PUT to keep the stored value. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Machine-readable event name |
| `origin` | `string` | Yes | Single origin the schema belongs to |
| `properties` | `object` | No | Property tree keyed by property name. Required with at least one key on POST; on PUT only the keys present are merged. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="properties full type">

```ts
Record<string, {
  description?: string,
  displayName?: string,
  group?: string,
  properties?: Record<string, {
    description?: string,
    displayName?: string,
    group?: string,
    properties?: Record<string, (recursive)>,
    type: string | stringList | integer | integerList | float | floatList | boolean | booleanList | date | dateList | struct | structList
  }>,
  type: string | stringList | integer | integerList | float | floatList | boolean | booleanList | date | dateList | struct | structList
}>
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `event` | `object \| null` | No | The stored event after the write was applied |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="event full type">

```ts
{
  displayName?: string | null,
  explicitlyDefined?: boolean | null,
  name?: string | null,
  origins?: string[] | null,
  properties?: Record<string, {
    description?: string | null,
    displayName?: string | null,
    explicitlyDefined?: boolean | null,
    group?: string | null,
    properties?: Record<string, {
      description?: string | null,
      displayName?: string | null,
      explicitlyDefined?: boolean | null,
      group?: string | null,
      properties?: Record<string, (recursive)> | null,
      type?: string | null
    }> | null,
    type?: string | null
  }> | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### queryMetadata

`events.queryMetadata`

List the event schemas the brand knows, per category, with their declared property types.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.events.queryMetadata({ category: 'automations' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `category` | `automations \| events \| segments` | Yes | Event category, resolved against the requested Omnisend-Version |
| `events` | `string[]` | No | Optional list of event names to filter by |
| `excludeCustomEvents` | `boolean` | No | When true, brand-custom events are omitted. When false or omitted, custom events are included. Set this to `true` when only well-known events are needed, for a more predictable response size. |
| `includeProperties` | `boolean` | No | When true, response items include the nested property tree. When false or omitted, only event-level metadata is returned. |
| `origins` | `string[]` | No | Optional list of origins to filter by (OR-combined) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `events` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of event metadata entries |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="events full type">

```ts
{
  displayName?: string | null,
  explicitlyDefined?: boolean | null,
  name?: string | null,
  origins?: string[] | null,
  properties?: Record<string, {
    description?: string | null,
    displayName?: string | null,
    explicitlyDefined?: boolean | null,
    group?: string | null,
    properties?: Record<string, {
      description?: string | null,
      displayName?: string | null,
      explicitlyDefined?: boolean | null,
      group?: string | null,
      properties?: Record<string, (recursive)> | null,
      type?: string | null
    }> | null,
    type?: string | null
  }> | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### send

`events.send`

Record an event for a contact, which creates or updates that contact and can trigger automations that email real customers. The event is queued (202) and append-only: it cannot be edited, read back or deleted. Omnisend's events guide asks for an origin on every event: use "api" unless your integration has its own origin.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.events.send({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contact` | `object` | No | Contact information, contact will be created or updated based on the data provided here. |
| `eventID` | `string` | No | UUID of the event (v4, v5, v6, v7). Along with 'eventTime' used for historical event deduplication (not working on real-time events used for automations). If not provided, it will be generated automatically. |
| `eventName` | `string` | No | Check event documentation to find what event names you need to specify for each event. |
| `eventTime` | `string` | No | ISO 8601 timestamp. Accepts RFC 3339 (e.g. "2021-07-01T00:00:00Z") and the space-separated form "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS±HH:MM" (e.g. "2021-07-01 00:00:00+02:00"). Timestamps earlier than UTC midnight 10 years before the current date are rejected. Optional; defaults to current time. |
| `eventVersion` | `string` | No | Required ONLY for recommended events. Check event documentation to find what version you need to specify for each event. For custom events you should leave it empty. |
| `origin` | `string` | No | It should be based on the source of event API. If you are building platform or app integration it should have dedicated origin. Otherwise it should be "api". |
| `properties` | `object` | No | Event properties, you can check events guides section to see what recommended properties you should provide for each event. Not providing recommending properties can result some of the features not working properly. |

<AccordionGroup>

### updateSchema

`events.updateSchema`

Merge changes into an event schema; the properties present change and none are deleted, and a declared type cannot change.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.events.updateSchema({ name: 'Spring sale', origin: 'api' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `displayName` | `string` | No | Human-readable label. Required on POST; omit on PUT to keep the stored value. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Machine-readable event name |
| `origin` | `string` | Yes | Single origin the schema belongs to |
| `properties` | `object` | No | Property tree keyed by property name. Required with at least one key on POST; on PUT only the keys present are merged. |

## Form Ab Setups

### create

`formAbSetups.create`

Create a form A/B setup. Create a draft form A/B setup from an existing popup, flyout or fullscreen form. Only those display types are eligible; the source form becomes the setup's main form and its two variants start as identical copies that can be edited independently afterward.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formAbSetups.create({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Main form unique identifier |
| `versions` | `object[]` | No | Two competing form variants. When omitted, both variants use a weight of 50 |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="versions full type">

```ts
{
  name?: string,
  weight?: number
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `autoClose` | `object \| null` | No | Auto-close policy configured when the test was started (read-only). Absent when the test does not close automatically. |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup enable timestamp (read-only) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup unique identifier (read-only) |
| `launchedAt` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup launch timestamp (read-only) |
| `mainForm` | `object \| null` | No | Main form of the A/B setup |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup status (read-only) |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `versions` | `object[] \| null` | No | Variant forms of the A/B setup |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="autoClose full type">

```ts
{
  endsAt?: string | null,
  stopOnSignificance?: boolean | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="mainForm full type">

```ts
{
  formID?: string | null,
  name?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="versions full type">

```ts
{
  formID?: string | null,
  name?: string | null,
  weight?: number | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### delete

`formAbSetups.delete`

Delete a form A/B setup. Delete a single form A/B setup by ID. Only draft form A/B setups can be deleted; enabled or completed setups cannot. Deleting a non-existent form A/B setup succeeds (idempotent).

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formAbSetups.delete({ abSetupID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d4' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `abSetupID` | `string` | Yes | Form A/B setup ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### list

`formAbSetups.list`

List form A/B setups. List form A/B setups with sorting and cursor-based pagination support. Each setup includes the auto-close policy configured when the test was started (if any).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formAbSetups.list({});
```

| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction (only needed on first request) |
| `status` | `draft \| enabled \| disabled` | No | Filter by status |

### selectWinner

`formAbSetups.selectWinner`

Select a form A/B setup winner. Select a winning variant for a form A/B setup by its version form ID. A winner can only be selected for an enabled (started) setup; selecting one concludes the test in favor of the chosen variant.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formAbSetups.selectWinner({ abSetupID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d4', versionFormID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `abSetupID` | `string` | Yes | Form A/B setup ID |
| `versionFormID` | `string` | Yes | Winner version form ID. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### start

`formAbSetups.start`

Start a form A/B setup. Start a form A/B test by ID. Launches the A/B setup so its variants begin serving to visitors according to their weights, moving the setup to enabled status. Starting a form A/B setup that has already been started returns a conflict.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formAbSetups.start({ abSetupID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d4' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `abSetupID` | `string` | Yes | Form A/B setup ID |
| `autoClose` | `object` | No | Optional auto-close policy applied when the test starts. Omit for a test that never closes automatically. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="autoClose full type">

```ts
{
  endsAt?: string,
  stopOnSignificance?: boolean
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

## Forms

### create

`forms.create`

Create form. Create a form with its full content and styling. New forms start in draft status and are not shown to visitors until enabled via POST /forms/&#123;formID&#125;/enable. Choosing a display type: - popup — modal centered over the page that dims the background.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.create({
	name: 'Newsletter popup',
	displayType: 'popup',
	content: {
		generalSettings: {
			body: { borderRadius: '0px', borderStyle: 'solid', borderWidth: '0px' },
			buttonPresets: [{
				id: 'primary_button',
				styles: {
					color: '#222222',
					fontFamily: 'Arial',
					fontSize: '14px',
					borderRadius: '4px',
					borderStyle: 'solid',
					borderWidth: '0px',
					fontStyle: 'normal',
					fontWeight: 'bold',
					textDecoration: 'none',
				},
			}],
			content: { color: '#222222', width: '400px' },
			fieldStyles: {
				errorColor: '#d00000',
				field: {
					borderColor: '#cccccc',
					borderRadius: '4px',
					borderStyle: 'solid',
					borderWidth: '1px',
					color: '#222222',
				},
				fontFamily: 'Arial',
				fontSize: '14px',
				label: { color: '#222222' },
				placeholder: { color: '#999999' },
			},
			link: { color: '#0066cc' },
			textPresets: [{
				id: 'paragraph',
				styles: {
					color: '#222222',
					fontFamily: 'Arial',
					fontSize: '14px',
					lineHeight: '125%',
				},
			}],
		},
		steps: [{
			sections: [{

						width: '100%',
						blocks: [{
							type: 'emailField',
							emailField: { errorMessage: 'Enter a valid email' },

							type: 'button',
							button: { type: 'submit', text: 'Subscribe' },
						}],
					}],
				}],
			}],
		}],
	},
});
```

---

### delete

`forms.delete`

Delete form. Delete a single form by ID. Forms can be deleted in any state (draft, enabled, disabled). Deleting a non-existent form succeeds (idempotent). When the form owns an A/B test setup, the setup and its version forms are deleted as well. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.delete({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### disable

`forms.disable`

Disable form. Disable a single form by ID. Disabling stops serving the form to visitors and moves it to disabled status; the form and its content are preserved and can be enabled again later. Disabling an already disabled form succeeds (idempotent).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.disable({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### enable

`forms.enable`

Enable form. Enable a single form by ID. Enabling publishes the form and starts serving it to visitors according to its targeting rules; the form moves to enabled status. Enabling an already enabled form succeeds (idempotent).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.enable({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### get

`forms.get`

Get form. Get a single form by ID, including its content, styling, targeting rules, and status. When the form is part of an A/B test, abSetupID and abStatus identify the setup it belongs to.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.get({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `abSetupID` | `string \| null` | No | A/B setup unique identifier the form belongs to (read-only) |
| `abStatus` | `string \| null` | No | A/B test status of the form (read-only) |
| `autoRedirect` | `object \| null` | No | Auto-redirect configuration applied after submission |
| `clickOutside` | `object \| null` | No | Click-outside-to-close behavior |
| `contactTags` | `string[] \| null` | No | Tags applied to contacts who submit the form |
| `content` | `object \| null` | No | Form content |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Form creation timestamp (read-only) |
| `disabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Form disable timestamp (read-only) |
| `displayType` | `string \| null` | No | Form display type |
| `doubleOptIn` | `object \| null` | No | Double opt-in configuration |
| `enabledAt` | `string \| null` | No | Form enable timestamp (read-only) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Form unique identifier (read-only) |
| `launchedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Form launch timestamp (read-only) |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Form name |
| `recaptcha` | `object \| null` | No | reCAPTCHA protection settings |
| `socialMediaSharing` | `object \| null` | No | Social media sharing metadata |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Form status (read-only) |
| `targeting` | `object \| null` | No | Form targeting rules |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Form last update timestamp (read-only) |

### getPeriodicReport

`forms.getPeriodicReport`

Get form periodic report. Get a time series of form performance statistics within a date range.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.getPeriodicReport({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2', createdAtFrom: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z', createdAtTo: '2026-11-28T00:00:00Z' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `createdAtFrom` | `string` | Yes | Start of the date range, inclusive (RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `createdAtTo` | `string` | Yes | End of the date range, inclusive (RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z) |
| `granularity` | `hour \| day \| week \| month \| year` | No | Time bucket granularity |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string \| null` | No | Form unique identifier (read-only) |
| `granularity` | `string \| null` | No | Time bucket size used for the rows (read-only) |
| `rows` | `object[] \| null` | No | Statistics rows, one per time bucket (read-only) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="rows full type">

```ts
{
  period?: string | null,
  statistics?: {
    interactions?: number | null,
    signups?: number | null,
    submits?: number | null,
    views?: number | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getReport

`forms.getReport`

Get form report. Get aggregated performance statistics for a single form within a date range. The response contains statistics (totals across all devices) and statisticsByDevice, the same counters split into the desktop, mobile, and tablet buckets. Device buckets with no activity in the range are omitted.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.getReport({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2', createdAtFrom: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z', createdAtTo: '2026-11-28T00:00:00Z' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `createdAtFrom` | `string` | Yes | Start of the date range, inclusive (RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `createdAtTo` | `string` | Yes | End of the date range, inclusive (RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string \| null` | No | Form unique identifier (read-only) |
| `statistics` | `object \| null` | No | Total statistics across all devices (read-only) |
| `statisticsByDevice` | `object \| null` | No | Statistics grouped by device type: desktop, mobile, tablet (read-only) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="statistics full type">

```ts
{
  interactions?: number | null,
  signups?: number | null,
  submits?: number | null,
  views?: number | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

```ts

} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`forms.list`

List forms. List forms with sorting and cursor-based pagination support.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Page size (1-250) |
| `after` | `string` | No | Cursor for next page (base64-encoded, obtained from previous response) |
| `before` | `string` | No | Cursor for previous page (base64-encoded, obtained from previous response) |
| `sort` | `createdAt \| updatedAt \| name` | No | Sort field (only needed on first request) |
| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction (only needed on first request) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `forms` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of forms |
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information |

### listAbSetupReports

`forms.listAbSetupReports`

List A/B setup reports for a form. Returns the results of the A/B tests of the given form. Each report covers one A/B setup and contains the period it ran for (startedAt, and completedAt once it finished), the winning version, and per-version statistics.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.listAbSetupReports({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `reports` | `object[] \| null` | No | A/B setup reports; empty when the form has none (read-only) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="reports full type">

```ts
{
  abSetupID?: string | null,
  completedAt?: string | null,
  startedAt?: string | null,
  status?: string | null,
  versionStatistics?: {
    splitValue?: number | null,
    statistics?: {
      interactions?: number | null,
      signups?: number | null,
      submits?: number | null,
      views?: number | null
    } | null,
    versionName?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  winner?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### listContacts

`forms.listContacts`

Get form submitted contacts. Get the contacts that signed up through the given form, most recent first by default, together with the values they submitted (email, phone, name, address fields, discount code, and custom properties). Pagination: results are cursor-based.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.listContacts({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Number of items to return (max 250) |
| `sort` | `createdAt` | No | Sort field. Contacts are ordered by contact creation time embedded in the contact ID. Note: the response 'date' field reflects when the contact submitted this form (signup time) and may differ from the sort key for existing subscribers. |
| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction |
| `after` | `string` | No | Cursor for forward pagination |
| `before` | `string` | No | Cursor for backward pagination |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contacts` | `object[] \| null` | No | Contacts who submitted the form (read-only) |
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information (read-only) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="contacts full type">

```ts
{
  address?: string | null,
  birthday?: string | null,
  city?: string | null,
  country?: string | null,
```

---

### render

`forms.render`

Render a form. Render a single form by ID and return its display steps as HTML. The form is rendered from its current stored content without enabling it or serving it to visitors, so the response can be used to preview how the form will look.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.render({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `steps` | `object[] \| null` | No | Rendered form steps |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="steps full type">

```ts
{
  html?: string | null,
  name?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### update

`forms.update`

Update form. Partially update a form. Only the fields present in the request body are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged. Nested objects must be sent complete, as they fully replace the stored value. Sending null for an optional field clears it, while sending null for a mandatory field is rejected.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.forms.update({ formID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d2' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formID` | `string` | Yes | Form ID |
| `autoRedirect` | `object \| null` | No | Auto-redirect configuration applied after submission |
| `clickOutside` | `object \| null` | No | Click-outside-to-close behavior |
| `contactTags` | `string[] \| null` | No | Tags applied to contacts who submit the form |
| `content` | `object` | No | Form content |
| `displayType` | `popup \| landingPage \| embedded \| flyout \| fullscreen` | No | Form display type |
| `doubleOptIn` | `object \| null` | No | Double opt-in configuration |
| `name` | `string` | No | Form name |
| `recaptcha` | `object \| null` | No | reCAPTCHA protection settings |
| `socialMediaSharing` | `object \| null` | No | Social media sharing metadata |
| `targeting` | `object` | No | Form targeting rules |

```ts
} | null
```

## Form Templates

### get

`formTemplates.get`

Get template. Get a single form template by ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formTemplates.get({ templateID: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d5' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `templateID` | `string` | Yes | Template ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contactTags` | `string[] \| null` | No | Tags applied to contacts who submit forms created from this template |
| `content` | `object \| null` | No | Template content |
| `displayType` | `string \| null` | No | Template display type |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Template unique identifier (read-only) |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Template name |
| `targeting` | `object \| null` | No | Template targeting rules |

---

### list

`formTemplates.list`

List form templates. List form templates with sorting, filtering and cursor-based pagination support. Only templates available in the brand's library are returned, each with its full content and brand assets applied.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.formTemplates.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Page size (1-250) |
| `after` | `string` | No | Cursor for next page (base64-encoded, obtained from previous response) |
| `before` | `string` | No | Cursor for previous page (base64-encoded, obtained from previous response) |
| `sort` | `createdAt` | No | Sort field (only needed on first request) |
| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction (only needed on first request) |
| `displayType` | `popup \| landingPage \| embedded \| flyout \| fullscreen` | No | Filter by display type |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `formTemplates` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of form templates |
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information |

```ts
});
```

## Products

### create

`products.create`

Create a catalog product with at least one variant; prices are floats in the store currency.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.products.create({
	currency: 'USD',
	id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0',
	status: 'inStock',
	title: 'Canvas sneaker',
	url: 'https://example.com/article',
});
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `categoryIDs` | `string[]` | No | — |
| `createdAt` | `string` | No | — |

| `defaultImageUrl` | `string` | No | DefaultImageUrl is recommended if more than one image is needed. Other product images should be added to the Images array. |

| `id` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `images` | `string[]` | No | — |

| `tags` | `string[]` | No | Tags can be used to categorize products. |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | — |

| `updatedAt` | `string` | No | — |
| `url` | `string` | Yes | Url should point to the product page on the website. |
| `variants` | `object[]` | No | Product variants are different versions of the same product. For example, a T-shirt can have different sizes and colors. |
| `vendor` | `string` | No | Vendor is the manufacturer or the brand of the product. |

| `segmentID` | `string \| null` | No | Segment unique identifier (read-only) |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Segment processing status (read-only) |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Segment last update timestamp (read-only) |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | Link that opens the segment in the Omnisend app (read-only) |

## Templates

### create

`templates.create`

Create an email template with a name and editor sections.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.create({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `generalSettings` | `object` | No | Template general settings - global and template level styles |
| `name` | `string` | No | Template name |
| `sections` | `object[]` | No | Template sections |

---

### delete

`templates.delete`

Delete an email template.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.delete({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Email Template ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### get

`templates.get`

Read one email template by id, with its sections and styles.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.get({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Email Template ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Template created at (read-only) |
| `generalSettings` | `object \| null` | No | Template general settings - global and template level styles |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Template unique identifier (read-only) |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Template name |
| `sections` | `object[] \| null` | No | Template sections |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Template updated at (read-only) |

---

### importFromHtml

`templates.importFromHtml`

Import raw HTML, up to 1 MB, as a new email template Omnisend converts to editor sections.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.importFromHtml({ html: '<html><body><p>Hello</p></body></html>', name: 'Spring sale' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `html` | `string` | Yes | Raw HTML content to import |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Template name |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Template created at (read-only) |
| `generalSettings` | `object \| null` | No | Template general settings - global and template level styles |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Template unique identifier (read-only) |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Template name |
| `sections` | `object[] \| null` | No | Template sections |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Template updated at (read-only) |

---

### list

`templates.list`

Page the email templates, filtered by name.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Number of items per page (1-100, default 50) |
| `after` | `string` | No | Cursor for next page (base64-encoded, from previous response) |
| `before` | `string` | No | Cursor for previous page (base64-encoded, from previous response) |
| `sort` | `createdAt \| name` | No | Sort field (createdAt, name; default createdAt) |
| `direction` | `asc \| desc` | No | Sort direction (asc, desc; default desc) |
| `nameContains` | `string` | No | Filter templates by name (case-insensitive partial match, max 200 characters) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information |
| `templates` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of email templates |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="paging full type">

```ts
{
  cursors?: {
    after?: string | null | null,
    before?: string | null | null
  } | null,
  hasMore?: boolean | null,
  limit?: number | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>

```ts
{

  id?: string | null,
  name?: string | null,
  updatedAt?: string | null
}[] | null
```

### render

`templates.render`

Render a template to its HTML for preview; nothing is sent and no state changes.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.render({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Email Template ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output:** `Record<string, string>`


---

### replace

`templates.replace`

Replace an email template in full; omitted fields drop to their defaults.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.templates.replace({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Email Template ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `generalSettings` | `object` | No | Template general settings - global and template level styles |
| `name` | `string` | No | Template name |
| `sections` | `object[]` | No | Template sections |

## Universal Layouts

### create

`universalLayouts.create`

Create universal layout. With this endpoint you can create a new universal layout.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.universalLayouts.create({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `content` | `object` | No | Universal layout content - the section structure |
| `name` | `string` | No | Universal layout name |

---

### delete

`universalLayouts.delete`

Delete universal layout. With this endpoint you can delete a universal layout by ID. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.universalLayouts.delete({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Universal Layout ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Omnisend accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### get

`universalLayouts.get`

Get universal layout. With this endpoint you can get a universal layout by ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.universalLayouts.get({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Universal Layout ID (24 character hexadecimal) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `content` | `object \| null` | No | Universal layout content - the section structure |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | Universal layout created at (read-only) |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Universal layout unique identifier (read-only) |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Universal layout name |
| `snapshotState` | `string \| null` | No | Universal layout snapshot state (read-only) |
| `snapshotUrl` | `string \| null` | No | Universal layout snapshot URL (read-only) |
| `updatedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Universal layout updated at (read-only) |

---

### list

`universalLayouts.list`

Get universal layouts. With this endpoint you can get a paginated list of universal layouts. Sorting: Items are returned in descending order by creation time (newest first). This is based on the internal document ID which contains a timestamp.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.universalLayouts.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Number of items per page (1-250, default 100) |
| `after` | `string` | No | Cursor for next page (base64-encoded, from previous response) |
| `before` | `string` | No | Cursor for previous page (base64-encoded, from previous response) |
| `nameContains` | `string` | No | Filter layouts by name (case-insensitive partial match, max 200 characters) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `paging` | `object \| null` | No | Pagination information |
| `universalLayouts` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of universal layouts |

---

### replace

`universalLayouts.replace`

Update universal layout. With this endpoint you can update (fully replace) a universal layout by ID.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.omnisend.api.universalLayouts.replace({ id: '6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Universal Layout ID (24 character hexadecimal) |
| `content` | `object` | No | Universal layout content - the section structure |
| `name` | `string` | No | Universal layout name |
